newsitem.title: USA: ECC Intl sees loss from unit's $1.2 mln loss.
newsitem.headline: ECC Intl sees loss from unit's $1.2 mln loss.

text.p: ECC International Corp said Wednesday it expects to report a loss for its second fiscal quarter as a result of its UK unit's performance.
The subsidiary, ECC Simulation Ltd, will report a $1.2 million net loss for the second quarter ended December 31, 1996, ECC International said.
ECC International said the subsidiary's revenue for the coming six quarters is expected to decline as a result of a lower than projected sales order level.
ECC International did not comment as to how much of a loss it would report in the second quarter ended December 31.
